text: huh, ok the WASD and painting landed great but the rotate camera from mouse wheel didnt seem to land at all for some reason
resolution: Middle-drag rotate didn't land because the onMiddleClick handler install went into host_props.applyMouseHandlerFlags, which only serves TUI/pop-out windows — the main GPU shell installs v8_app.zig's own parallel applyHandlerFlags copy, so the editor viewport's Pressable never got its js_on_middle_click expression and the engine's middle-button dispatch found nothing to call. Added the same onMiddleClick install (plus the null-reset) to v8_app.zig's copy. WASD-paint and the other req_2704 fixes were host-side and unaffected. Needs a dev-host rebuild to take effect.
